name: read_group_and_source_openings
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd()
for name in ['group','transversal','ordered']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(lane/'sources'/f'{name}.pdf'),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{name}.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print(name,'CHARS',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout if name=='group' else r.stdout[:6500])
